name: Potion of Healing
description: You regain 2d4 + 2 hit points when you drink this potion.

name: Potion of Greater Healing
description: You regain 4d4 + 4 hit points when you drink this potion.

name: Potion of Superior Healing
description: You regain 8d4 + 8 hit points when you drink this potion.

name: Potion of Supreme Healing
description: You regain 10d4 + 20 hit points when you drink this potion.

name: Bag of Holding
description: This bag has an interior space considerably larger than its outside dimensions. The bag can hold up to 500 pounds, not exceeding a volume of 64 cubic feet. The bag weighs 15 pounds, regardless of its contents.

features.name: Extradimensional Space
features.description: Holds up to 500 lbs / 64 cubic feet regardless of bag weight.

name: +1 Weapon
description: You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

features.name: Magic Bonus
features.description: +1 to attack rolls and damage rolls.

name: +2 Weapon
description: You have a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

features.name: Magic Bonus
features.description: +2 to attack rolls and damage rolls.

name: +3 Weapon
description: You have a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

features.name: Magic Bonus
features.description: +3 to attack rolls and damage rolls.

name: +1 Armor
description: You have a +1 bonus to AC while wearing this armor.

name: Cloak of Protection
description: You gain a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws while you wear this cloak.

features.name: Protection
features.description: +1 bonus to AC and all saving throws.

name: Ring of Protection
description: You gain a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws while wearing this ring.

features.name: Protection
features.description: +1 bonus to AC and all saving throws.

name: Boots of Speed
description: While you wear these boots, you can use a bonus action and click the boots' heels together to double your walking speed. In addition, difficult terrain doesn't cost you extra movement. The effect ends if you use a bonus action to click your heels again or if you are no longer wearing the boots.

features.name: Haste
features.description: Bonus action: double walking speed and ignore difficult terrain until deactivated.

name: Gauntlets of Ogre Power
description: Your Strength score is 19 while you wear these gauntlets. They have no effect on you if your Strength is already 19 or higher.

name: Headband of Intellect
description: Your Intelligence score is 19 while you wear this headband. It has no effect on you if your Intelligence is already 19 or higher.

name: Amulet of Health
description: Your Constitution score is 19 while you wear this amulet. It has no effect on you if your Constitution is already 19 or higher.

name: Wand of Magic Missiles
description: This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can use an action to expend 1 or more of its charges to cast the magic missile spell from it. For 1 charge, you cast the 1st-level version of the spell. You can increase the spell slot level by one for each additional charge you expend. The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn.

features.name: Magic Missiles
features.description: 7 charges. Expend 1+ charges to cast Magic Missile (1st level + 1 per extra charge). Regain 1d6+1 charges at dawn.

name: Rope of Climbing
description: This 60-foot length of silk rope weighs 3 pounds and can hold up to 3,000 pounds. If you hold one end of the rope and use an action to speak the command word, the rope animates. As a bonus action, you can command the other end to move toward a destination you choose.

features.name: Animate
features.description: Command word animates the rope. Bonus action to direct it. Holds 3,000 lbs.
